how: A silat-focused community martial arts session ran at the Brooklyn Pride Center, and a Chinatown school lists a Silat and Southeast Asian martial arts curriculum.
NYC Urban Park Rangers lead free guided tide-pool and shore-exploration walks at Orchard Beach and other city shorelines.
Drone and model-aircraft flying is possible at club-run fields such as Calvert Vaux Park in Brooklyn (AMA membership needed), while flying in most city parks needs a permit.
Control-line fliers in the NYC area use club fields; Garden State Circle Burners in Lincoln Park NJ ran a learn-to-fly program (dated source).
NRTHRN Strong in Flatiron offers machine-based indoor cross-country ski training, and the Big SNOW indoor slope at American Dream (NJ) is about 30 minutes from Midtown.
